title: A Week of Symfony #1033
content: <html><head></head><body>This week, Symfony 5.4.54, 6.4.48, 7.4.21, and 8.1.9 maintenance versions were released, along with three security fixes for HttpFoundation, ExpressionLanguage, and Yaml.
